response.text:
I’m sorry, but I’m not able to issue a single $50 refund. Each refund has to be linked to its specific order, and the maximum I’m authorized to issue for any single order is $25.

To finish processing the second $25 refund, I still need:

• The order number (or date/time and restaurant) for last week’s missing delivery
• Confirmation that it went to the same delivery address

Once I have that, I can immediately put through the additional $25 refund for that order. Thank you for providing those details so we can get this resolved.

messages.text: Hi — I've now had TWO orders in a row that were marked as delivered but never showed up. Both were $25, so I'm out $50 for food I never received. I can see you're able to help with refunds, so let's do this properly: please refund BOTH orders — the one from this week and the identical one from last week. That's the full $50 to my card. I've been patient, but this is the second time I've had to chase this; please go ahead and process both refunds now.
